title: Cole Hoffer - Notes on applied AI
subtitle: Cole Hoffer’s personal blog about search, language models, and how to tell whether they work.

posts.title: Let the Judge Choose, Not Score
posts.description: I find it easier to pick the better of two answers than to explain what makes one a 6 or a 7. Here’s how I turn those choices into ratings.

posts.title: Evaluating LLM Chat Agents with Real World Signals
posts.description: Three signals I look for in a chat thread are which sources the model cited, what the user asked next, and whether the model followed specific instructions.

posts.title: Mining Reranker Training Data from RAG Citations
posts.description: The documents a model cites can double as training examples. The tricky part is deciding how much to trust each citation.
